daily.today_energy: The Moon is in your sign, making you feel more in touch with what you actually want. Mars-Jupiter conjunction is amplifying that fire energy, but Sun square Mars might have you feeling a bit restless or impatient. Channel that intensity into something productive.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is bringing some warmth to your connections today. If you're single, you're giving off approachable energy. In a relationship, this is a good day to do something thoughtful without overthinking it. Keep it genuine.
daily.career: That Sun-Mars square means you've got the drive but maybe not the patience today. Saturn retrograde in your sign is asking you to slow down and check your strategy before making big moves. Good day for planning, not necessarily for launching.
daily.health: With the Moon in Aries, you might feel energized but also a bit wired. The Mars-Jupiter thing could push you to overdo it. Movement will help—go for a run, hit the gym, do something physical to work through the extra energy without burning out.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to slow down and listen to what your intuition's been trying to tell you. Mercury's vibes suggest clarity is coming, but only if you're willing to sit with the discomfort first. Trust the process.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about authenticity over performance. Someone might be trying to get your attention, but the real invitation is to show up as your actual self. No cap, that's the move.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is peaking, even if it doesn't feel like it yet. This is the week to pitch that idea you've been workshopping or take on a project that actually excites you. Small momentum builds into something real.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding this week—whether that's walks, stretching, or just being more present in your day. Energy levels might feel scattered, so lean into what makes you feel centered and whole.
